prompt.generated_prompt_string: A tightly framed vertical 3:4 retro analog portrait of three adult Japanese people seated in a cramped police-booth-like interior. Center an adult Japanese woman with chestnut-brown hair in a ponytail and short straight bangs, wearing a fitted powder-blue police-uniform shirt with gold buttons and epaulettes, dark green neck scarf, navy skirt, dark belt, and white gloves. She sits upright with hands folded quietly in her lap and a calm direct gaze. Two older Japanese policemen crop in close on either side, creating a compressed trio composition seen through a worn doorway. Keep aged wall panels, scuffed edges, a faint sign, deep booth shadows, and crisp uniform hardware. Light with one soft tungsten practical at approximately 3000K for warm facial highlights and dense edge shadow. Shoot at eye level on a 35mm camera with a 40mm lens; use low-saturation print color, visible fine grain, slight color shift, shallow depth, and an unpolished 1980s Japanese analog documentary aesthetic.
